chunks.sanskrit: pu̠nāti̍ te pari̠srutaṃ̠ somaṃ̠ sūrya̍sya duhi̠tā |
tamī̠maṇvīḥ̎ sama̠rya ā gṛ̠bhṇanti̠ yoṣa̍ṇo̠ daśa̍ |
ā va̍cyasva̠ mahi̠ psaro̠ vṛṣe̎ndo dyu̠mnava̍ttamaḥ |
adhu̍kṣata pri̠yaṃ madhu̠ dhārā̎ su̠tasya̍ ve̠dhasaḥ̍ |
sa̠mu̠dro a̠psu mā̎mṛje viṣṭa̠mbho dha̠ruṇo̎ di̠vaḥ |
taṃ tvā̠ madā̎ya̠ ghṛṣva̍ya u lokakṛ̠tnumī̎mahe |
go̠ṣā i̎ndo nṛ̠ṣā a̍syaśva̠sā vā̎ja̠sā u̠ta |
e̠ṣa de̠vo vi̠pā kṛ̠to'ti̠ hvarāṃ̎si dhāvati |
e̠ṣa viśvā̎ni̠ vāryā̠ śūro̠ yanni̍va̠ satva̍bhiḥ |
e̠ṣa divaṃ̠ vi dhā̎vati ti̠ro rajāṃ̎si̠ dhāra̍yā |
e̠ṣa pra̠tnena̠ janma̍nā de̠vo de̠vebhyaḥ̍ su̠taḥ |
e̠ṣa u̠ sya pu̍ruvra̠to ja̍jñā̠no ja̠naya̠nniṣaḥ̍ |
sanā̎ ca soma̠ jeṣi̍ ca̠ pava̍māna̠ mahi̠ śravaḥ̍ |
sanā̠ jyotiḥ̠ sanā̠ sva1̍(a̠)rviśvā̎ ca soma̠ saubha̍gā |
sanā̠ dakṣa̍mu̠ta kratu̠mapa̍ soma̠ mṛdho̎ jahi |
tvaṃ sūrye̎ na̠ ā bha̍ja̠ tava̠ kratvā̠ tavo̠tibhiḥ̍ |
u̠bhā de̠vā nṛ̠cakṣa̍sā̠ hotā̎rā̠ daivyā̎ huve |
i̠maṃ no̎ ya̠jñamā ga̍man ti̠sro de̠vīḥ su̠peśa̍saḥ || 8 ||
ma̠ndrayā̎ soma̠ dhāra̍yā̠ vṛṣā̎ pavasva deva̠yuḥ |
a̠bhi tyaṃ madyaṃ̠ mada̠minda̠vindra̠ iti̍ kṣara |
a̠bhi tyaṃ pū̠rvyaṃ madaṃ̎ suvā̠no a̍rṣa pa̠vitra̠ ā |
anu̍ dra̠psāsa̠ inda̍va̠ āpo̠ na pra̠vatā̎saran |
ā̠tmā ya̠jñasya̠ raṃhyā̎ suṣvā̠ṇaḥ pa̍vate su̠taḥ |
pra dhārā̠ madhvo̎ agri̠yo ma̠hīra̠po vi gā̎hate |
pra yu̠jo vā̠co a̍gri̠yo vṛṣāva̍ cakrada̠dvane̎ |
pari̠ yat kāvyā̎ ka̠virnṛ̠mṇā vasā̎no̠ arṣa̍ti |
pava̍māno a̠bhi spṛdho̠ viśo̠ rāje̎va sīdati |
avyo̠ vāre̠ pari̍ pri̠yo hari̠rvane̎ṣu sīdati |
ā mi̠trāvaru̍ṇā̠ bhagaṃ̠ madhvaḥ̍ pavanta ū̠rmayaḥ̍ |
a̠smabhyaṃ̎ rodasī ra̠yiṃ madhvo̠ vāja̍sya sā̠taye̎ |
indra̍sya soma̠ rādha̍se punā̠no hārdi̍ codaya |
mṛ̠janti̍ tvā̠ daśa̠ kṣipo̎ hi̠nvanti̍ sa̠pta dhī̠tayaḥ̍ |
ma̠ghona̠ ā pa̍vasva no ja̠hi viśvā̠ apa̠ dviṣaḥ̍ |
vṛ̠ṣṭiṃ di̠vaḥ pari̍ srava dyu̠mnaṃ pṛ̍thi̠vyā adhi̍ |
prapra̠ kṣayā̎ya̠ panya̍se̠ janā̎ya̠ juṣṭo̎ a̠druhe̎ |
tā a̠bhi santa̠mastṛ̍taṃ ma̠he yuvā̎na̠mā da̍dhuḥ |
avā̠ kalpe̎ṣu naḥ puma̠stamāṃ̎si soma̠ yodhyā̎ |
nū navya̍se̠ navī̎yase sū̠ktāya̍ sādhayā pa̠thaḥ |
pava̍māna̠ mahi̠ śravo̠ gāmaśvaṃ̎ rāsi vī̠rava̍t |
pra svā̠nāso̠ rathā̎ i̠vārva̎nto̠ na śra̍va̠syavaḥ̍ |
pari̍ suvā̠nāsa̠ inda̍vo̠ madā̎ya ba̠rhaṇā̎ gi̠rā |
apa̠ dvārā̎ matī̠nāṃ pra̠tnā ṛ̎ṇvanti kā̠ravaḥ̍ |
nābhā̠ nābhiṃ̎ na̠ ā da̍de̠ cakṣu̍ści̠t sūrye̠ sacā̎ |
sa naḥ̍ pavasva̠ śaṃ gave̠ śaṃ janā̎ya̠ śamarva̍te |
a̠mi̠tra̠hā vica̍rṣaṇiḥ̠ pava̍sva soma̠ śaṃ gave̎ |
indrā̎ya soma̠ pāta̍ve̠ madā̎ya̠ pari̍ ṣicyase |
pava̍māna su̠vīryaṃ̎ ra̠yiṃ so̎ma rirīhi naḥ |
a̠bhi viprā̎ anūṣata̠ gāvo̎ va̠tsaṃ na mā̠taraḥ̍ |
yaḥ somaḥ̍ ka̠laśe̠ṣvām̐ a̠ntaḥ pa̠vitra̠ āhi̍taḥ |
a̠bhi pri̠yā di̠vaspa̠dā somo̎ hinvā̠no a̍rṣati |
te naḥ̍ saha̠sriṇaṃ̎ ra̠yiṃ pava̎ntā̠mā su̠vīrya̎m |
gi̠rā yadī̠ saba̎ndhavaḥ̠ pañca̠ vrātā̎ apa̠syavaḥ̍ |
āda̍sya śu̠ṣmiṇo̠ rase̠ viśve̎ de̠vā a̍matsata |
na̠ptībhi̠ryo vi̠vasva̍taḥ śu̠bhro na mā̎mṛ̠je yuvā̎ |
pari̍ di̠vyāni̠ marmṛ̍śa̠d viśvā̎ni soma̠ pārthi̍vā |
e̠ṣa hi̠to vi nī̎yate̠'ntaḥ śu̠bhrāva̍tā pa̠thā |
e̠ṣa vasū̎ni pibda̠nā paru̍ṣā yayi̠vām̐ ati̍ |
e̠tamu̠ tyaṃ daśa̠ kṣipo̎ mṛ̠janti̍ sa̠pta dhī̠tayaḥ̍ |
pra te̎ so̠tāra̍ o̠ṇyo̠3̍(o̠) rasaṃ̠ madā̎ya̠ ghṛṣva̍ye |
ana̍ptama̠psu du̠ṣṭaraṃ̠ somaṃ̎ pa̠vitra̠ ā sṛ̍ja |
pra pu̍nā̠nasya̠ ceta̍sā̠ somaḥ̍ pa̠vitre̎ arṣati |
pra tvā̠ namo̎bhi̠rinda̍va̠ indra̠ somā̎ asṛkṣata |
pu̠nā̠no rū̠pe a̠vyaye̠ viśvā̠ arṣa̎nna̠bhi śriyaḥ̍ |
di̠vo na sānu̍ pi̠pyuṣī̠ dhārā̎ su̠tasya̍ ve̠dhasaḥ̍ |
tvaṃ so̎ma vipa̠ścitaṃ̠ tanā̎ punā̠na ā̠yuṣu̍ |
pra ni̠mnene̎va̠ sindha̍vo̠ ghnanto̎ vṛ̠trāṇi̠ bhūrṇa̍yaḥ |
ā ka̠laśe̎ṣu dhāvati pa̠vitre̠ pari̍ ṣicyate |
ati̠ trī so̎ma roca̠nā roha̠nna bhrā̎jase̠ diva̎m |
a̠bhi viprā̎ anūṣata mū̠rdhan ya̠jñasya̍ kā̠ravaḥ̍ |
tamu̍ tvā vā̠jinaṃ̠ naro̎ dhī̠bhirviprā̎ ava̠syavaḥ̍ |
pari̍ suvā̠no gi̍ri̠ṣṭhāḥ pa̠vitre̠ somo̎ akṣāḥ |
ā yo viśvā̎ni̠ vāryā̠ vasū̎ni̠ hasta̍yorda̠dhe |
ya i̠me roda̍sī ma̠hī saṃ mā̠tare̎va̠ doha̍te |
pari̠ yo roda̍sī u̠bhe sa̠dyo vāje̎bhi̠rarṣa̍ti |
yat so̎ma ci̠tramu̠kthyaṃ̎ di̠vyaṃ pārthi̍vaṃ̠ vasu̍ |
yu̠vaṃ hi sthaḥ sva̍rpatī̠ indra̍śca soma̠ gopa̍tī |
ni śatroḥ̎ soma̠ vṛṣṇyaṃ̠ ni śuṣmaṃ̠ ni vaya̍stira |
sa hi ṣmā̎ jari̠tṛbhya̠ ā vājaṃ̠ goma̎nta̠minva̍ti |
pari̠ viśvā̎ni̠ ceta̍sā mṛ̠śase̠ pava̍se ma̠tī |
a̠bhya̍rṣa bṛ̠had yaśo̎ ma̠ghava̍dbhyo dhru̠vaṃ ra̠yim |
tvaṃ rāje̎va suvra̠to giraḥ̍ so̠mā vi̍veśitha |
krī̠ḷurma̠kho na maṃ̎ha̠yuḥ pa̠vitraṃ̎ soma gacchasi |
e̠ta u̠ tye a̍vīvaśa̠n kāṣṭhāṃ̎ vā̠jino̎ akrata |
e̠te somā̎sa ā̠śavo̠ rathā̎ iva̠ pra vā̠jinaḥ̍ |
e̠te mṛ̠ṣṭā ama̍rtyāḥ sasṛ̠vāṃso̠ na śa̍śramuḥ |
tvaṃ so̎ma pa̠ṇibhya̠ ā vasu̠ gavyā̎ni dhārayaḥ |
anu̍ pra̠tnāsa̍ ā̠yavaḥ̍ pa̠daṃ navī̎yo akramuḥ |
ā pa̍vamāna no bharā̠ryo adā̎śuṣo̠ gaya̎m |
a̠bhi somā̎sa ā̠yavaḥ̠ pava̎nte̠ madyaṃ̠ mada̎m |
a̠bhi gāvo̎ adhanviṣu̠rāpo̠ na pra̠vatā̎ ya̠tīḥ |
śuciḥ̍ pāva̠ka u̍cyate̠ somaḥ̍ su̠tasya̠ madhvaḥ̍ |
saṃ de̠vaiḥ śo̎bhate̠ vṛṣā̎ ka̠viryonā̠vadhi̍ pri̠yaḥ |
a̠ru̠ṣo ja̠naya̠n giraḥ̠ somaḥ̍ pavata āyu̠ṣak |
ā pa̍vasva madintama pa̠vitraṃ̠ dhāra̍yā kave |
taṃ tvā̎ hinvanti ve̠dhasaḥ̠ pava̍māna girā̠vṛdha̎m |
e̠ṣa indrā̎ya vā̠yave̎ sva̠rjit pari̍ ṣicyate |
e̠ṣa nṛbhi̠rvi nī̎yate di̠vo mū̠rdhā vṛṣā̎ su̠taḥ |
e̠ṣa sūrye̎ṇa hāsate̠ pava̍māno̠ adhi̠ dyavi̍ |
e̠ṣa pa̠vitre̎ akṣara̠t somo̎ de̠vebhyaḥ̍ su̠taḥ |
saptiṃ̎ mṛjanti ve̠dhaso̎ gṛ̠ṇantaḥ̍ kā̠ravo̎ gi̠rā |
su̠ṣahā̎ soma̠ tāni̍ te punā̠nāya̍ prabhūvaso |
viśvā̠ vasū̎ni saṃ̠jaya̠n pava̍sva soma̠ dhāra̍yā |
rakṣā̠ su no̠ ara̍ruṣaḥ sva̠nāt sa̍masya̠ kasya̍ cit |
endo̠ pārthi̍vaṃ ra̠yiṃ di̠vyaṃ pa̍vasva̠ dhāra̍yā |
pra dhārā̎ asya śu̠ṣmiṇo̠ vṛthā̎ pa̠vitre̎ akṣaran |
ā naḥ̠ śuṣmaṃ̎ nṛ̠ṣāhyaṃ̎ vī̠rava̎ntaṃ puru̠spṛha̎m |
pra somo̠ ati̠ dhāra̍yā̠ pava̍māno asiṣyadat |
ā pyā̎yasva̠ same̎tu te vi̠śvataḥ̍ soma̠ vṛṣṇya̎m |
tubhyaṃ̠ gāvo̎ ghṛ̠taṃ payo̠ babhro̎ dudu̠hre akṣi̍tam |
svā̠yu̠dhasya̍ te sa̠to bhuva̍nasya pate va̠yam |
pra somā̎so mada̠cyutaḥ̠ śrava̍se no ma̠ghonaḥ̍ |
u̠bhe so̎māva̠cāka̍śan mṛ̠go na ta̠kto a̍rṣasi |
a̠bhi gāvo̎ anūṣata̠ yoṣā̎ jā̠rami̍va pri̠yam |
a̠sme dhe̎hi dyu̠mad yaśo̎ ma̠ghava̍dbhyaśca̠ mahyaṃ̎ ca |
a̠bhi droṇā̎ni ba̠bhravaḥ̍ śu̠krā ṛ̠tasya̠ dhāra̍yā |
ti̠sro vāca̠ udī̎rate̠ gāvo̎ mimanti dhe̠navaḥ̍ |
ā naḥ̍ pavasva̠ dhāra̍yā̠ pava̍māna ra̠yiṃ pṛ̠thum |
viśvo̠ yasya̎ vra̠te jano̎ dā̠dhāra̠ dharma̍ṇa̠spateḥ̎ |
asa̍rji̠ rathyo̎ yathā pa̠vitre̎ ca̠mvoḥ̎ su̠taḥ |
sa vahniḥ̍ soma̠ jāgṛ̍viḥ̠ pava̍sva deva̠vīrati̍ |
sa no̠ jyotīṃ̎ṣi pūrvya̠ pava̍māna̠ vi ro̎caya |
sa viśvā̎ dā̠śuṣe̠ vasu̠ somo̎ di̠vyāni̠ pārthi̍vā |
sa su̠taḥ pī̠taye̠ vṛṣā̠ somaḥ̍ pa̠vitre̎ arṣati |
sa vā̠jī ro̎ca̠nā di̠vaḥ pava̍māno̠ vi dhā̎vati |
e̠ṣa u̠ sya vṛṣā̠ ratho'vyo̠ vāre̎bhirarṣati |
e̠taṃ tyaṃ ha̠rito̠ daśa̍ marmṛ̠jyante̎ apa̠syuvaḥ̍ |
e̠ṣa sya mānu̍ṣī̠ṣvā śye̠no na vi̠kṣu sī̎dati |
e̠ṣa sya madyo̠ raso'va̍ caṣṭe di̠vaḥ śiśuḥ̍ |
e̠ṣa sya pī̠taye̎ su̠to hari̍rarṣati dharṇa̠siḥ |
su̠ta e̎ti pa̠vitra̠ ā tviṣiṃ̠ dadhā̎na̠ oja̍sā |
a̠yaṃ sa yo di̠vaspari̍ raghu̠yāmā̎ pa̠vitra̠ ā |
nū no̎ ra̠yiṃ ma̠hāmi̎ndo̠'smabhyaṃ̎ soma vi̠śvataḥ̍ |
sa naḥ̍ punā̠na ā bha̍ra ra̠yiṃ sto̠tre su̠vīrya̎m |
pu̠nā̠na i̎nda̠vā bha̍ra̠ soma̍ dvi̠barha̍saṃ ra̠yim |
pra ye gāvo̠ na bhūrṇa̍yastve̠ṣā a̠yāso̠ akra̍muḥ |
sa pa̍vasva vicarṣaṇa̠ ā ma̠hī roda̍sī pṛṇa |
pari̍ ṇaḥ śarma̠yantyā̠ dhāra̍yā soma vi̠śvataḥ̍ |
du̠hā̠naḥ pra̠tnamit payaḥ̍ pa̠vitre̠ pari̍ ṣicyate |
yo atya̍ iva mṛ̠jyate̠ gobhi̠rmadā̎ya harya̠taḥ |
taṃ no̠ viśvā̎ ava̠syuvo̠ giraḥ̍ śumbhanti pū̠rvathā̎ |
pu̠nā̠no yā̎ti harya̠taḥ somo̎ gī̠rbhiḥ pari̍ṣkṛtaḥ |
indu̠ratyo̠ na vā̎ja̠sṛt kani̍kranti pa̠vitra̠ ā |
pra ṇa̍ indo ma̠he tana̍ ū̠rmiṃ na bibhra̍darṣasi |
ma̠tī ju̠ṣṭo dhi̠yā hi̠taḥ somo̎ hinve parā̠vati̍ |
a̠yaṃ de̠veṣu̠ jāgṛ̍viḥ su̠ta e̎ti pa̠vitra̠ ā |
sa no̠ bhagā̎ya vā̠yave̠ vipra̍vīraḥ sa̠dāvṛ̍dhaḥ |
sa no̎ a̠dya vasu̍ttaye kratu̠vid gā̎tu̠vitta̍maḥ |
sa pa̍vasva̠ madā̎ya̠ kaṃ nṛ̠cakṣā̎ de̠vavī̎taye |
sa no̎ arṣā̠bhi dū̠tya1̍(aṃ̠) tvamindrā̎ya tośase |
u̠ta tvāma̍ru̠ṇaṃ va̠yaṃ gobhi̍rañjmo̠ madā̎ya̠ kam |
atyū̎ pa̠vitra̍makramīd vā̠jī dhuraṃ̠ na yāma̍ni |
tayā̎ pavasva̠ dhāra̍yā̠ yayā̎ pī̠to vi̠cakṣa̍se |
ā dhā̎vatā suhastyaḥ śu̠krā gṛ̍bhṇīta ma̠nthinā̎ |
sa pa̍vasva dhanaṃjaya praya̠ntā rādha̍so ma̠haḥ |
e̠taṃ mṛ̍janti̠ marjyaṃ̠ pava̍mānaṃ̠ daśa̠ kṣipaḥ̍ |
āt soma̍ indri̠yo raso̠ vajraḥ̍ sahasra̠sā bhu̍vat |
taṃ tvā̎ nṛ̠mṇāni̠ bibhra̍taṃ sa̠dhasthe̎ṣu ma̠ho di̠vaḥ |
tayā̎ pavasva̠ dhāra̍yā̠ yayā̠ gāva̍ i̠hāgama̍n |
sa na̍ ū̠rje vya1̍(a̠)vyayaṃ̎ pa̠vitraṃ̎ dhāva̠ dhāra̍yā |
pra̠sa̠ve ta̠ udī̎rate ti̠sro vāco̎ makha̠syuvaḥ̍ |
avyo̠ vāre̠ pari̍ pri̠yaṃ hariṃ̎ hinva̠ntyadri̍bhiḥ |
ā pa̍vasva madintama pa̠vitraṃ̠ dhāra̍yā kave |
adhva̎ryo̠ adri̍bhiḥ su̠taṃ somaṃ̎ pa̠vitra̠ ā sṛ̍ja |
tava̠ tya i̎ndo̠ andha̍so de̠vā madho̠rvya̍śnate |
tvaṃ hi so̎ma va̠rdhaya̍n tsu̠to madā̎ya̠ bhūrṇa̍ye |
śa̠taṃ na̍ inda ū̠tibhiḥ̍ sa̠hasraṃ̎ vā̠ śucī̎nām |
utte̠ śuṣmā̎so asthū̠ rakṣo̎ bhi̠ndanto̎ adrivaḥ |
taṃ hi̎nvanti mada̠cyutaṃ̠ hariṃ̎ na̠dīṣu̍ vā̠jina̎m |
a̠sya pra̠tnāmanu̠ dyutaṃ̎ śu̠kraṃ du̍duhre̠ ahra̍yaḥ |
pari̍ ṇo de̠vavī̎taye̠ vājām̐̎ arṣasi̠ goma̍taḥ |
yavaṃ̎yavaṃ no̠ andha̍sā pu̠ṣṭampu̍ṣṭaṃ̠ pari̍ srava |
indo̠ yathā̠ tava̠ stavo̠ yathā̎ te jā̠tamandha̍saḥ |
yo ji̠nāti̠ na jīya̍te̠ hanti̠ śatru̍ma̠bhītya̍ |
pari̠ soma̍ ṛ̠taṃ bṛ̠hadā̠śuḥ pa̠vitre̎ arṣati |
yat somo̠ vāja̠marṣa̍ti śa̠taṃ dhārā̎ apa̠syuvaḥ̍ |
a̠bhi tvā̠ yoṣa̍ṇo̠ daśa̍ jā̠raṃ na ka̠nyā̎nūṣata |
pra te̠ dhārā̎ asa̠ścato̎ di̠vo na ya̎nti vṛ̠ṣṭayaḥ̍ |
a̠bhi pri̠yāṇi̠ kāvyā̠ viśvā̠ cakṣā̎ṇo arṣati |
sa no̠ viśvā̎ di̠vo vasū̠to pṛ̍thi̠vyā adhi̍ |
